title: Global uniqueness of semilinear Galerkin solutions: the planar case and three-dimensional restrictions
abstract: We prove eventual global uniqueness for the full two-dimensional catalogue problem, without an angle condition or a growth bound on the reaction. In three dimensions, we exclude bounded spurious branches and prove global uniqueness for positive separable reactions. The general three-dimensional target remains unresolved.

title: An exact error floor for adaptive Monte Carlo approximation of a noncompact operator
abstract: For the canonical embedding $\ell_1\hookrightarrow\ell_\infty$, we prove that the optimal worst-case root-mean-square error is exactly $1/2$ at every positive finite expected information budget. The proof permits adaptive continuous linear information and the joint measurability conventions of AIM 523. We also give compactness and separable-target consequences.

title: A linear information bound for nonsymmetric convex classes under scalar-error measurability
abstract: We extend the $27n$ comparison of Krieg, Novak and Ullrich to the scalar-error measurability convention in AIM 568. A finite-dimensional measurable-majorant lemma supplies the bridge without assuming that the original adaptive rules or reconstruction are measurable. The source theorem supplies the geometric lower bound; the contribution here is this bridge.

title: Discontinuous information can improve randomized recovery on an incomplete normed space
abstract: On $F=(\ell_1,\|\cdot\|_2)$, for $S(x)=\|x\|_2^2$ on the unit ball, every finite expected-budget algorithm using continuous linear information has optimal root-mean-square error $1/2$. One discontinuous algebraic linear query attains error at most $\sqrt6-2<1/2$. This is a counterexample to AIM 569 as stated for normed spaces; no conclusion for Banach spaces alone is claimed.

title: Noisy continuous sensing of a Sobolev ellipsoid: a uniform upper bound
abstract: We construct adaptive continuous noisy measurements for the Sobolev ellipsoid in AIM 639. Writing $L=\log_2(1/\delta)$, the bound is $e_{n,\delta}\le256/[L\log_2(1+2^n/L)]$. It matches known lower bounds in two parameter regimes. A transition gap remains, so this is partial progress on the joint asymptotic target.

title: Quartic simplex interpolation: a tetrahedral Fej\'er theorem and a dimension-free fourth-power bound
abstract: For Bos's prescribed quartic interpolation nodes, we prove the Fej\'er inequality on a tetrahedron and the fourth-power inequality in every dimension, including the equality set. Finite exact-arithmetic witnesses and reconstructing verifiers are supplied. These resolve assertions 2 and 4 of AIM 641; the all-dimensional quartic Fekete assertion remains unresolved.

title: Global convergence of the simple CRDT iteration for quadrilaterals
abstract: We prove global convergence of the four-prevertex CRDT simple iteration for every simple quadrilateral, including concave quadrilaterals. For the catalogue algorithm this applies when its prescribed boundary subdivision leaves four vertices. Polygons and quadrilaterals with additional subdivision vertices remain unresolved.
